fato_historico: 2008: Lehman Brothers files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, the largest bankruptcy filing in U.S. history.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to release old structures that no longer serve your growth. Just as history shows how even the largest empires can reset their foundations, you may find that letting go of past burdens creates space for a stronger, more resilient version of yourself to emerge. It is a good time to rebuild your inner stability.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the courage to begin again with a hopeful heart.
significado_numero: Represents a powerful gateway for intuition and new spiritual beginnings today.
conselho: Consider tidying your workspace to invite fresh, positive energy into your daily routine.
